what: Colored dots scattered over the photo pop in one by one at .5s intervals starting 1s after the scene turns on, then shrink in four steps with no in-between values and vanish — .75x at the moment of appearing, then .5 · .25 · 0 every 375ms (gone at 1.125s). A hero decoration that feels like bubbles popping. Send fx:play when the photo changes to make it burst again from the start

options.delay: Time from turning on to first dot (s), default 1
options.dur: Time for one dot to burst (seconds), default 1.5 — the four steps each take 1/4 of this length
options.every: Repeat interval (seconds), default 0 (once) — to match a photo slideshow, use its interval (Brand 5) or fx:play
options.on: If “event”, it doesn’t fire as soon as it attaches, only when fx:play arrives at the element
options.[data-fx-part=dot]: Burst dots (several) — position·size·color come from the consumer’s CSS. They start hidden at scale 0

note: The original applies keyframes 0→.25→.5→.75→1 as 1.5s step-end reverse forwards — measured in the browser, only the 0ms instant is 1 and it goes down from .75 right away, so the part sets the same values with a forward step-end

from.where: index.html .hero five-color droplet dots on each photo (.dots .k-dot) — original c-hero-dot-show: 1s after the photo turns on, is-show at .5s intervals, 1.5s step-end reverse forwards
from.options: on: event (fx:play each time the photo changes)
